sourcePolicy: Repository Android assets only; no network or currency/purchase functionality

sizePolicy.note: Lossless image/font optimization; original dimensions preserved

imagePolicy.sourceSelection: Largest Android PNG pixel area; deterministic lexical tie-break
imagePolicy.encoding: Tutorials, thumbnails and icg icons: lossless WebP at original dimensions; UI bitmaps: original PNG; vectors: path/color-preserving SVG

audioPolicy.encoding: MP3 mono VBR q7 (LAME), 44100Hz, metadata stripped
audioPolicy.integration: SoundService opens the four MP3 rawfiles

fontPolicy: Referenced Roboto fonts subset to ArkTS-used glyphs; TTF with original outlines and layout features

drawablePolicy.vectors: media SVG; exact path geometry, original dimensions and ARGB alpha
drawablePolicy.statefulAndStretchable: Parsed only to build SVG media; raw Android XML and drawable JSON are not packaged
drawablePolicy.currency: No coin, reward, online, purchase, replay-for-currency assets or behavior introduced; gold trophy tier is original artwork

catalogPolicy.writeScope: media function only; GAMES, game parameters and other code preserved
